verifications.claim: Rory McIlroy held off challenges from Cameron Young and Justin Rose to win the 2026 Masters Tournament by one stroke.
verifications.label: INCORRECT

verifications.reasoning: McIlroy held off Young and Rose (both T3 at -10), but won by 2 strokes over them, not 1; 1 stroke margin is over Scheffler (-11). Margin incorrectly attributed.
